page_title: MON 5-2 MET | Monaco v Metz 21/09/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' Stephanie Frappart is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+6' Gauthier Hein (Metz) looks like he will be the one to take the corner kick.
90+3' 5 - 2 Goal - 5:2! Stanis Idumbo laid the ball off to George Ilenikhena (Monaco), who shot from close range into the bottom right corner, leaving the goalkeeper helpless.
90+1' Krepin Diatta (Monaco) reacts well to get to the rebound and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but he fails to get the ball through the players standing between him and the goal.
90' The fourth official shows 6 min. of added time.
90' Here is a change. Koffi Kouao is going off and Stephane Le Mignan gives the last tactical orders to Morgan Bokele Mputu (Metz).
90' Today's match ends for Benjamin Stambouli who will be replaced by Georgiy Tsitaishvili (Metz).
88' Lamine Camara (Monaco) steps up to take the corner, but the ball just sails in among the defenders.

86' 4 - 2 It's an own goal! A pitiful moment for Koffi Kouao (Metz), who tries to clear a cross into the six-yard box from the corner but instead sends the ball behind his own keeper. The score is 4:2.
86' Lamine Camara (Monaco) steps up to send the ball in.

83' 3 - 2 Krepin Diatta sends a superb cross into the box. Ansu Fati (Monaco) latches on to it and from close range plants a header inside the left post, leaving Jonathan Fischer beaten. He displayed his eye for goal there - excellent finish. The score is 3:2.
82' The Monaco players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
80' Adi Hutter has decided to substitute Kassoum Ouattara and he is replaced by Caio Henrique (Monaco).
80' It is time for a substitution. Stanis Idumbo (Monaco) is on for Takumi Minamino.
77' Kassoum Ouattara (Monaco) looks to break free, but his touch lets him down and he loses the ball.
76' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Monaco comes to nothing.
75' Stephane Le Mignan prepares a substitution. Fode Ballo-Toure is replaced by Alpha Toure (Metz).
75' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Jessy Deminguet departs the field of play to be replaced by Ismael Guerti (Metz).
74' A pass by Maghnes Akliouche (Monaco) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end. The ball goes out of play and Metz will have a goal kick.
72' Monaco are ruled offside.

70' Kassoum Ouattara (Monaco) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Stephanie Frappart with no other option than to blow for a foul.
67' Adi Hutter has decided to introduce fresh legs, with George Ilenikhena (Monaco) replacing Mika Biereth.
67' 2 - 2 GOAL! That’s a great strike from the spot by Gauthier Hein (Metz) into the left of the net, giving goalkeeper Philipp Kohn no chance!
67' Gauthier Hein (Metz) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
65' It’s a PENALTY to Metz after the VAR review!
65' Wait! The referee makes the VAR signal and he's going to review that incident in the box from earlier. This could be a penalty for Metz! Let's see what he decides.
64' There's a melee in the box, but the referee isn't interested in the appeals from Metz for a penalty. Play continues.
60' The referee blows his whistle as Jessy Deminguet (Metz) was too aggressive in his challenge.
58' Mika Biereth (Monaco) commits a rough challenge and Stephanie Frappart blows his whistle for a foul.
57' The resulting corner from Gauthier Hein (Metz) comes to nothing.
56' Great save! Maghnes Akliouche (Monaco) had time and space inside the box after picking up a neat pass, but his shot towards the roof of the net was brilliantly saved by Jonathan Fischer.
53' Fode Ballo-Toure (Metz) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
50' Gauthier Hein (Metz) whips in the corner, but one of the defending players gets a head on it and intercepts.
50' Cheikh Sabaly (Metz) strikes the ball towards goal, but it fails to reach the target after being well blocked by one of the defenders. Metz get a corner.
49' Takumi Minamino (Monaco) collects a pass inside the box and unleashes a shot which is brilliantly blocked by a defender.

49' Ambitious effort from Gauthier Hein (Metz). He finds himself in a great position after collecting a precise pass inside the penalty area and goes for goal, but it never troubles the goalkeeper and flies well over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Monaco.
46' 2 - 1 Lamine Camara provides Ansu Fati (Monaco) with a nice pass inside the box. It allows him to finish with a low shot into the middle of the goal.
46' Adi Hutter has made a change at the break. Ansu Fati has come on in place of Paris Brunner (Monaco).
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+5' The match has reached half-time.
45+1' It looks like Habib Diallo (Metz) saw red with that tackle. Stephanie Frappart won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul.
45' We will have 4 min. of added time.
43' Stephanie Frappart shows a yellow card to Jordan Teze (Monaco) for his blatant foul.
43' Jessy Deminguet (Metz) is able to continue to play.
42' Jessy Deminguet (Metz) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
40' Krepin Diatta (Monaco) commits a rough foul. Stephanie Frappart stops the game and makes a call.

40' Lamine Camara (Monaco) attempts to threaten the goalkeeper from the free kick on the edge of the box. He produces a stunning blast which only flies inches over the crossbar. It could have been a beautiful goal! The ball goes out of play and Metz will have a goal kick.
39' Terry Yegbe (Metz) commits a rough challenge and Stephanie Frappart blows his whistle for an infringement. Monaco are awarded a free kick. Let's see what they create from this.
38' The free kick from long range, taken by Monaco, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
38' Terry Yegbe (Metz) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Stephanie Frappart has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
37' A defender unwittingly blocks the ball on the line after a snap shot from Habib Diallo (Metz) inside the box following a slide rule pass.

36' Mika Biereth (Monaco) looks very eager to impress, does well to beat his man and force a cross into the box, where one of his teammates gets his head on the ball, but it's too easy for the keeper.
36' Paris Brunner (Monaco) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Stephanie Frappart no option but to blow his whistle.
35' Takumi Minamino (Monaco) forces a pass into the box, but Jonathan Fischer is alert and does a great job to rob him of the ball.
33' Aladji Bamba (Monaco) just cannot continue due to injury and has to be substituted. Krepin Diatta replaces him.
33' The game is interrupted. Maghnes Akliouche (Monaco) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did.
31' The corner from Lamine Camara (Monaco) is intercepted by Jonathan Fischer.
30' Takumi Minamino (Monaco) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked. The ball is out of play and Monaco manage to earn a corner.
28' 1 - 1 Goal! Mika Biereth (Monaco) fires home from very close range after latching on to a pass from Takumi Minamino. The score is 1:1.
26' 0:2 – the total goal attempt statistics.
21' Metz quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.

20' Koffi Kouao (Metz) receives a precise pass in the box and takes the shot early. The ball heads towards the bottom left corner, but Philipp Kohn shows off his skills and makes a brilliant save to deny him. Metz have been awarded a corner kick.
19' Neat passing move from Metz in order to create new attacking opportunities. The percentage of ball possession is – 44:56.
17' Takumi Minamino (Monaco) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
16' Monaco enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
13' 0 - 1 It's in the back of the net! Cheikh Sabaly slips the ball through to Habib Diallo (Metz), and he darts into the box to unleash a magnificent shot inside the right post. He makes it 0:1.
10' Mika Biereth (Monaco) makes a strong challenge and Stephanie Frappart blows for a foul.
9' Metz can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
7' Aladji Bamba (Monaco) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul.
2' Stephanie Frappart blows his whistle after Takumi Minamino (Monaco) brings one of his opponents down with a strong tackle.
1' The match has just started.
Metz will kick-off.
Let us introduce today's referee to you, and it's Stephanie Frappart.
Show lineups The starting lineups of both teams are already revealed and you can check them out in the details of this match.
